sample_unit: clinical pathology and laboratory medicine vignette cases

links.outcome: Unsafe or guideline-discordant recommendations and primary diagnostic concordance in laboratory medicine vignettes
links.effect: Unsafe or guideline-discordant recommendations in 2% (ChatGPT-5.2), 4% (Gemini), 5% (DeepSeek); fully concordant primary diagnoses in 88%, 84%, 82% of cases.
links.quote: Unsafe or guideline-discordant recommendations were uncommon but present (2%, 4%, 5%).

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares the performance and safety of several commercial LLMs on a 100-case vignette benchmark in laboratory medicine without testing an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
